item.title: 🇷🇺 Opening remarks by President of Russia Vladimir Putin during the meeting with President of Kazakhstan Kassym-Jomart Tokayev on the sidelines of the SCO Summit
item.description: 🇷🇺 🇰🇿 Opening remarks by President of Russia Vladimir Putin during the meeting with President of Kazakhstan Kassym-Jomart Tokayev on the sidelines of the SCO Summit (Bishkek, August 31, 2026) . 💬 Vladimir Putin: I am very pleased to see you again – this time on the sidelines of events related to the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation . Before we begin, I would like to personally congratulate you on the results of the Kurultai parliamentary elections. I would also like to note the high voter turnout and, most importantly, the election results, which confirm that the people of Kazakhstan support the course you have chosen for the country’s further development, strengthening its domestic political stability, advancing the economy and, on that basis, addressing a broad range of social issues and improving people’s living standards. ☝️ That is what people voted for. Our bilateral relations are developing dynamically across virtually all areas. Trade figures were solid in 2026, and trade has grown further this year. #RussiaKazakhstan

item.title: 🗓 On August 31, President of Russia Vladimir Putin attended the opening ceremony of
item.description: 🗓 On August 31, President of Russia Vladimir Putin attended the opening ceremony of the VI World Nomad Games at Bishkek Arena. Ahead of the ceremony, the Heads of delegations invited to the event were welcomed by President of Kyrgyzstan Sadyr Japarov and his wife. *** The World Nomad Games are an international sports and cultural event dedicated to preserving and promoting the traditions of nomadic civilizations . They have been held since 2014. The VI World Nomad Games will take place on September 1-6, featuring competitions in 43 traditional sports disciplines , alongside an extensive cultural program. Around 3,000 athletes representing more than 100 countries will compete. 🇷🇺 #TeamRussia is represented by more than 230 athletes from 33 Russian regions .

item.title: 🇷🇺 Embassy of Russia in Indonesia On August 31 2026, at the personal initiative of staff members of Russian diplomatic missions and representative offices in Jakarta and in respons
item.description: 🇷🇺 🇮🇩 Embassy of Russia in Indonesia : On August 31 2026, at the personal initiative of staff members of Russian diplomatic missions and representative offices in Jakarta and in response to a request from residents of Nagekeo, East Nusa Tenggara Province, humanitarian assistance for communities impacted by the earthquake on Flores Island was delivered to Indonesia’s National Agency for Disaster Management . The assistance included rice, cooking oil, instant noodles, and other essential food and household supplies intended to support local families in need . 🤝 The initiative reflects genuine solidarity with those affected by the earthquake and aims to support local communities during this difficult time. #RussiaIndonesia #RussiaHelps

Opening remarks
by President of Russia Vladimir Putin during
the meeting
with Prime Minister of India Narendra Modi on the sidelines of the SCO Summit
(Bishkek, August 31, 2026)
.
💬
President Putin:
I am very glad to meet with you
again
.
This time, our meeting is taking place on the eve of
the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation Summit
– an organisation that works
to deepen contacts among the countries of the Global South and East
, promotes the region’s socioeconomic and cultural development, and contributes to building a just
#MultipolarWorld
.
🤝
I am also pleased to note that
Russia-India relations continue to strengthen
on the principles of
a special and privileged strategic partnership
.
Mr Prime Minister, this is undoubtedly facilitated by
your personal attention to the development of Russia-India relations
, as well as by
the close personal friendship
that has developed between us, for which I am very grateful to you.
Recently, Foreign Minister of India
Subrahmanyam Jaishankar
, during
our meeting in Moscow
, conveyed your message, and I fully share everything set out in it.
Next year, we will mark
the 80th anniversary of
the establishment of diplomatic relations
, and, of course, we are seriously preparing for
the upcoming #BRICS Summit in New Delhi
in September.
📈
Trade and economic cooperation is showing positive trends overall
. There was a slight decline last year, but in the first half of 2026,
trade turnover increased by 2.6%.
A week ago,
the Intergovernmental Commission met in Moscow
and also reported good results.
I would also like to say a few words about
humanitarian cooperation
. India is among the leaders in terms of the number of students studying in Russia:
over the past 10 years, their number has increased sevenfold and now stands at almost 40,000
.
Cultural festivals
are held regularly – both Indian culture festivals and Russian culture festivals. The next one is scheduled to take place
in India in 2027
.
Tourist exchanges
are also developing rapidly
, increasing by 16% in 2025.
🌐
We closely coordinate our efforts
within the
#UN
,
#BRICS
,
#G20
and, of course, the
#SCO
. Today, we have a very good opportunity to compare notes and chart the way forward in developing Russia-India relations.
#RussiaIndia
#DruzhbaDosti

🇷🇺
🇨🇳
Opening remarks
by President of Russia Vladimir Putin during
the meeting
with President of China Xi Jinping on the sidelines of the SCO Summit
(Bishkek, August 31, 2026)
.
💬
President Putin:
I am sincerely glad
to meet with you again
– this time in Kyrgyzstan.
I would like to begin with
the tragic events
that recently occurred in China’s Tibet Autonomous Region, near the border with Nepal – a powerful mudslide struck the area, resulting in loss of life.
▪️
Please convey
our deepest condolences
to the families and loved ones of those who lost their lives, as well as
our wishes for a speedy recovery
to all those injured.
***
We are meeting just a few hours before the start of
the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation Summit
.
☝️
The SCO was established 25 years ago at the initiative of China and Russia.
I am very pleased to note that our initiative has developed so successfully, acquired a truly broad international character and grown into a full-fledged international organisation.
This year we also marked
the 25th anniversary of the fundamental
Treaty of Good-Neighbourliness and Friendly Cooperation
, signed by Comrade
Jiang Zemin
, who would have turned 100 on August 17. We remember his contribution to the development of Russia-China relations.
Today, amid a complex geopolitical environment,
the comprehensive partnership and strategic interaction between Russia and China
serve as a model of interstate relations.
🤝
They are founded on strong traditions of friendship, respect for sovereignty, equality and mutual benefit.
Cooperation is developing successfully across all areas, including the economy
. We are implementing major projects in energy, industry, space, transport and logistics. The first regular voyage by a Chinese container ship along
the Northern Sea Route
took place in mid-August.
Mutual agricultural trade
is growing rapidly – up 34%
.
Digital innovation
, including artificial intelligence technologies,
is opening up new opportunities
for the economic development of our countries
. Together with our Chinese friends, we established
the World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization
in 2026. This was your initiative, which we were pleased to support, and we are committed to working together in this field.
Business and humanitarian contacts are undoubtedly facilitated by
the 30-day visa-free regime
. You announced this initiative a year ago, on September 2, during
our meeting in Beijing
.
We supported it, and the arrangement is now in effect through the end of 2027.
The results were immediate:
tourist flows increased by 43% in the first half of 2026
. We are ready to work together on
making the visa-free regime permanent
, should the Chinese Side consider this possible and beneficial.
🌐
As for current foreign policy issues,
our fundamental approaches are close or fully aligned
. In addition to the
#SCO
, we actively cooperate within the
#UN
,
#BRICS
,
#G20
and ASEAN-centred formats, and, of course, we will continue supporting
China’s chairmanship of #APEC.
#RussiaChina
